content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Los Alamos

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP® credential. Los Alamos professionals in research, engineering, and national-security roles often exceed these thresholds. Review PMI's official eligibility checklist and gather documentation of your background before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our course condenses core PMI frameworks, processes, and real-world scenarios into an intensive format that fits working schedules. You'll earn the formal contact hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, complete your official PMI application and pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through submission requirements and answer questions about the process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your PMP® exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the computer-based assessment at an authorized test center or remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, sustain the credential by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and workshops to help you meet PMI's renewal requirements and stay current in project-management practice.
